args.text:
Batch audit: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. I flagged 1 run and cleared 7.

Flagged:
- r03, reason width_free_ratio_used. It was reported with the width-free ratio, but its plane-sections value (0.554 against a threshold of 3.25) was well under the limit, so a change in root width does not explain the switch. Its largest flank difference is −7.97 %/h at 432 µm. The batch median is 0.495 %/h, so this is about 8.5 %/h off with the opposite sign: a different profile shape that the width-free reporting hides. Its centre REGR peak (53.02 %/h at 421 µm) and growth zone (695 µm) match the batch.

Cleared:
- r01, r05 and r08 used no remedy and pass all checks. Their summaries are within |z| ≤ 0.67.
- r02 kept the width-free remedy, but its profile matches the batch.
- r04 has large |z| values only because the batch spread is very small. In absolute terms its growth zone is 21 µm shorter (3 %) and its flank difference is about 1.3 %/h off. Its peak and peak position match the batch, and its checks pass.
- r06 and r07 pass all checks. Their peak flank difference is near the batch median, and its position (21 µm) reflects a nearly flat flank-difference profile.

What the flagged runs share: only r03 was flagged. Its flank difference does not fit the rest of the batch, and it was reported with the width-free ratio even though the plane-sections check would have passed.
